hooks.name: Kiro journal entry on task completion
hooks.description: When a spec task is completed, append a dated entry to docs/KIRO_LOG.md for the Kiro write-up.

action.prompt:
A spec task was just completed. Append (never rewrite) an entry to docs/KIRO_LOG.md using this exact format:

### <YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM> — <spec name> / task <id>: <task title>
- **Built:** 1–2 sentences on what now exists (files, functions).
- **Kiro features used:** which of spec, steering (name the file), hooks (name them), MCP (name the server), property-based tests, powers, sub-agents actually helped, and how.
- **Went wrong / changed:** bugs, failing tests that caught something, spec changes. Write "Nothing notable" if true.
- **Tests:** result of the latest `npx vitest --run` (pass/fail counts) if tests exist.

Keep it under 8 lines and factual; no hype. Use the current local time.
